articles.title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Oct. 26, 2026
articles.summary: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Oct. 26, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

articles.title: New Hampshire Army National Guard names 2027 Best Warrior winners
articles.summary: PEMBROKE, N.H. — Sgt. Johnathin Bailey and Pfc. Samuel Gosselin earned the New Hampshire Army National Guard's 2027 Noncommissioned Officer and Soldier of the Year titles after three days of marksmanship, land navigation and physical challenges Oct. 23-25.

articles.title: BCE Consulting outlines the critical elements of layered air defense architecture
articles.summary: What does the future of layered air defense look like? BCE Consulting lays out what it will take to protect American forces.

articles.title: Is the Pentagon’s demand signal for drones working? It depends on who you ask.
articles.summary: “There’s a lot of positive signaling, but we need to see the whites of the eyes: We need to see sustained, normalized demand,” said James Slider, CEO of Performance Drone Works.

articles.title: U.S. Civil Affairs Soldiers build NATO partnerships at Estonian shooting competition
articles.summary: Two U.S. Army Civil Affairs Soldiers competed alongside service members from Estonia, the United Kingdom and France during the Estonian Defence Forces Shooting Competition 2026 in Harju County, Estonia, from Oct. 21-22.

articles.title: BS27-1: MAD for Military Assisted Departure
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 718th Force Support Squadron worked in conjunction with various units across the 18th Wing and joint services to coordinate a military assisted departure during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026.

articles.title: BS27-1: Ready to defend
articles.summary: KADENA AIR BASE, Japan – U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th Logistics Readiness Squadron issued weapons to personnel participating in Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026. The weapons issue prepares Airmen to respond to simulated threats and operate in a contingency environment.

articles.title: BS27-1: 18th SFS neutralizes the threat
articles.summary: When shots are fired, 18th Security Forces Squadron rushes toward the source. U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th SFS responded to a simulated ground attack during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026, neutralizing two simulated attackers and testing their ability to respond to evolving threats.

articles.title: Faces of Keen Sword 27 - Cpt. Yuki Sato
articles.summary: Japan Air Self-Defense Force Cpt. Yuki Sato, a Kawasaki C-2 Pilot assigned to the 402nd Tactical Airlift Squadron at Iruma Air Base, Japan poses for a feature photo for a Faces of Keen Sword feature story.

articles.title: Faces of Keen Sword 27 - Joshua Dilone
articles.summary: U.S. Navy Petty Officer 2nd Class Joshua Dilone, an operational specialist, shares information on his job duties and his experiences in Keen Sword 27. Keen Sword is a multilateral exercise dedicated to preserving peace and stability in the region, and strengthening the ironclad alliance between the U.S. and Japan.

articles.title: U.S. Army and NATO Partners Rehearse War Strategies
articles.summary: In Wiesbaden, the U.S. Army and its NATO partners are rehearsing a real-world emergency scenario. A simulated attack on NATO’s eastern flank is designed to test the alliance’s defensive capabilities.

articles.title: Ballenger Honored, Deal Introduced as Newest Georgia Army National Guard State Command Sgt. Maj.
articles.summary: U.S. Army Command Sergeant Major John Ballenger transitions into retirement and passes the torch to U.S. Army Command Sergeant Major Lafayette Deal as the incoming Georgia Army National Guard Command Sergeant Major.

articles.title: NATO FLF Battle Group-Poland celebrates Romanian Armed Forces Day with sports competition
articles.summary: Romanian soldiers deployed with NATO’s Battle Group-Poland marked Romania’s Armed Forces Day with allied U.S., Croatian and British troops at Bemowo Piskie Training Area. A Romanian-led competition featured volleyball, indoor soccer and table tennis, giving soldiers a chance to build camaraderie beyond their regular duties.

articles.title: FOX SPORTS TO HONOR U.S. MILITARY AND VETERANS DURING SPECIAL BROADCASTS AT THE U.S. NAVAL ACADEMY AND WEST POINT
articles.summary: In honor of Veterans Day, FOX Sports, in coordination with the U.S. Military Academy and the U.S. Naval Academy, will broadcast two of its flagship sports programs live from West Point and the U.S. Naval Academy over the weekend of Nov. 7–8.

articles.title: JROTC National Raider Challenge | Fall 2026
articles.summary: Fort Knox, Ky. – U.S. Army Cadet Command hosted the JROTC National Raider Challenge bringing approximately 4,000 cadets from across the country to Fort Knox, Oct. 22-25 to test their grit as they attempt to bring home the National Raider Champion title.
